description: This Java class defines a custom exception ContentManagementException used within the Content Management module of the Fineract project. It extends AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException and provides constructors for various error scenarios related to file handling and content repository issues.

classes.name: ContentManagementException
classes.description: A custom exception class for content management errors, providing specific constructors for different error contexts related to file processing.

methods.description: Constructor for creating an exception instance when there is an error manipulating a file identified by filename.
